entries.name: Box
entries.summary: Lowest-level theme-aware layout and semantic surface primitive.
useWhen: A one-off layout rule does not justify a reusable component.
avoidWhen: The recipe repeats, carries state, or needs a stable public API.
accessibility: Set component to the correct semantic element; Box adds no semantics.
resilience: Use minWidth: 0, intrinsic height, and wrapping for untrusted content.

agent.instruction: Use only as local layout glue after checking for a named component or pattern.

entries.name: Stack
entries.summary: One-dimensional responsive spacing and flow primitive.
useWhen: Related children share one vertical or horizontal flow.
avoidWhen: Rows and columns both need alignment; use CSS Grid instead.
accessibility: Preserve DOM order and use list semantics when the content is a list.
resilience: Use flex wrapping and minWidth: 0 for labels and localized content.

agent.instruction: Prefer Stack to child-owned margins for one-dimensional composition.

entries.name: Heading
entries.summary: Semantic heading level paired independently with a visual typography variant.
useWhen: A page, section, card, dialog, or region needs a navigable title.
avoidWhen: The text is decorative metadata or not part of the document outline.
accessibility: Keep levels sequential and provide one visible h1 per page.
resilience: Use fluid variants, balanced wrapping, and overflowWrap for long titles.

agent.instruction: Choose the HTML level from structure first, then select the visual variant.

entries.name: Text
entries.summary: Token-driven body, supporting, label, and metadata text.
useWhen: Rendering readable prose, labels, descriptions, or supporting metadata.
avoidWhen: The copy should be a heading, control label, or specialized rich-content renderer.
accessibility: Do not encode meaning with colour or visual variant alone.
resilience: Cap prose near 70ch and allow long, translated, and user-authored text to wrap.

agent.instruction: Use theme variants instead of one-off font sizes, weights, or colours.

entries.name: Container
entries.summary: Canonical responsive gutters and width caps for page sections and prose.
useWhen: A page region needs to align with the system grid or readable measure.
avoidWhen: A treatment must bleed to the viewport edge; nest Container inside it instead.
accessibility: Set component to the appropriate landmark and avoid duplicate main landmarks.
resilience: Choose prose, content, wide, or full by content need; do not add local max-widths.

agent.instruction: Use as the alignment boundary for app and marketing sections.

entries.name: BrandButton
entries.summary: Primary, secondary, ghost, loading, and link-like brand action control.
useWhen: A user can submit, continue, open, navigate, or trigger a meaningful action.
avoidWhen: The interaction is passive metadata or plain inline navigation.
accessibility: Use truthful button or link semantics and preserve a stable accessible name while loading.
resilience: Labels may wrap; use fullWidth only when the surrounding layout calls for it.

agent.instruction: Use the least-emphatic variant that still communicates action hierarchy.

entries.name: BrandChip
entries.summary: Compact operational metadata and status chip.
useWhen: A short status or classification supports nearby content.
avoidWhen: The label is decorative, sentence-length, or an action disguised as metadata.
accessibility: Do not rely on colour alone to communicate state.
resilience: Keep labels concise while allowing localization to grow.

agent.instruction: Use for operational metadata; verify visually because a dedicated story is pending.

entries.name: LabelTag
entries.summary: Short evidence or category label with restrained visual emphasis.
useWhen: A compact label helps scan a card, metric, or section.
avoidWhen: Every section would receive the same decorative eyebrow.
accessibility: Keep the label meaningful in text and do not make colour its only signal.
resilience: Allow labels to wrap rather than clipping translated content.

agent.instruction: Use sparingly where the label adds information, never as repeated decoration.

entries.name: BlogCard
entries.summary: Article preview with image, metadata, title, summary, and navigation semantics.
useWhen: Listing editorial or knowledge content with enough context to choose an article.
avoidWhen: Only a compact title link is needed or the item is not editorial content.
accessibility: Provide accurate image alt text and a descriptive article link.
resilience: Supports missing imagery and long titles without fixed-height clipping.

agent.instruction: Use within BlogListTemplate or a semantic article list.

entries.name: AccordionList
entries.summary: Disclosure list for independently expandable question-and-answer content.
useWhen: Several independent answers or details should remain scannable when collapsed.
avoidWhen: Users must compare all content simultaneously or the sequence is mandatory.
accessibility: Each trigger needs a unique accessible name and keyboard-operable expanded state.
resilience: Expanded content grows intrinsically and accepts long localized copy.

agent.instruction: Prefer the FAQList pattern for FAQ sections; use this only for lower-level disclosures.

entries.name: CardSurface
entries.summary: Flat token-driven content surface with bounded variants and semantic element support.
useWhen: Content needs a real visual and semantic grouping boundary.
avoidWhen: Spacing or a divider is enough, or the result would create nested cards.
accessibility: Choose the semantic element that matches the grouped content.
resilience: Use intrinsic height and let children wrap; avoid decorative broad shadows.

agent.instruction: Confirm a card is the correct information affordance before using it.

entries.name: GlassCard
entries.summary: Legacy atmospheric surface retained for bounded branded compositions.
useWhen: An existing branded surface specifically requires the established translucent treatment.
avoidWhen: Building a new default card, dashboard panel, or nested content surface.
accessibility: Verify text contrast against the actual backdrop and preserve visible focus.
resilience: Provide a solid fallback and do not rely on backdrop blur for hierarchy.

agent.instruction: Do not introduce in new work without an explicit existing-brand requirement.

entries.name: FeatureImage
entries.summary: Responsive feature imagery with system framing and image semantics.
useWhen: A product, project, or editorial feature needs a decisive visual asset.
avoidWhen: The image is decorative filler or a credible asset is not available.
accessibility: Use descriptive alt text for meaningful imagery and empty alt for decoration.
resilience: Reserve aspect ratio and test crop behaviour at mobile and wide viewports.

agent.instruction: Use real project imagery and inspect responsive cropping before completion.

entries.name: MetricCard
entries.summary: Evidence-led project metric with supporting label and description.
useWhen: A measured outcome needs concise context and a truthful source.
avoidWhen: The number is decorative, fabricated, or lacks enough context to interpret.
accessibility: Write units and labels so the value is understandable without visual position.
resilience: Long labels and values wrap without fixed-height clipping.

agent.instruction: Use only for verified outcomes; never generate placeholder metrics.

entries.name: TestimonialCard
entries.summary: Attributed customer quotation with person and organization context.
useWhen: A verified customer quotation supports a specific claim.
avoidWhen: The quotation, attribution, or relationship cannot be verified.
accessibility: Use quotation semantics and meaningful avatar alt text when an image is present.
resilience: Long quotes and titles grow intrinsically without truncation.

agent.instruction: Preserve supplied wording and attribution; do not fabricate social proof.

entries.name: DecodeText
entries.summary: Brand text reveal that preserves readable fallback and reduced-motion output.
useWhen: One high-value headline or label benefits from the established technical reveal.
avoidWhen: Repeated content, body copy, or essential information would be delayed.
accessibility: Keep a stable accessible name and return final text immediately for reduced motion.
resilience: Content remains visible if animation or client-side JavaScript does not run.

agent.instruction: Use once per view at most, only where motion reinforces the hierarchy.

entries.name: SectionShell
entries.summary: Canonical section spacing, width, and semantic boundary.
useWhen: A page needs a major content section aligned to the system rhythm.
avoidWhen: The content belongs inside an existing section or needs true full-bleed treatment.
accessibility: Provide a heading or accessible label when the section is a landmark.
resilience: Uses canonical responsive spacing and intrinsic content height.

agent.instruction: Use as the default page-section boundary before inventing local spacing.

entries.name: SectionHeader
entries.summary: Section title, optional label, and supporting copy with bounded measure.
useWhen: A major section needs a clear title and concise orientation.
avoidWhen: A label would repeat decorative eyebrow grammar or the section needs only a heading.
accessibility: Set the correct sequential heading level.
resilience: Long headings and supporting copy wrap within readable measures.

agent.instruction: Use for substantial sections and omit the label unless it carries information.

entries.name: FullWidthSection
entries.summary: Viewport-wide treatment with an internally aligned content container.
useWhen: A meaningful section treatment must reach the viewport edge.
avoidWhen: The section only needs ordinary spacing or another full-width section is adjacent.
accessibility: Keep reading order and section labelling independent of the visual treatment.
resilience: The outer surface bleeds while inner content retains canonical gutters.

agent.instruction: Use sparingly to create pacing, not as the default wrapper for every section.

entries.name: Header
entries.summary: Responsive site header with brand, navigation, action, and mobile menu behaviour.
useWhen: A frontend needs SSH Tech global navigation and a bounded primary action.
avoidWhen: The surface is embedded, modal, or intentionally has no global navigation.
accessibility: Provide an accessible navigation label, visible focus, and operable mobile menu.
resilience: Navigation items wrap or collapse without hiding essential routes.

agent.instruction: Use for top-level navigation; supply real routes and remove unavailable actions.

entries.name: ProofCardGrid
entries.summary: Responsive collection of verified project metrics and evidence points.
useWhen: Several comparable verified outcomes support one proof narrative.
avoidWhen: Items are not comparable or a list, case study, or chart communicates them better.
accessibility: Each item remains understandable in reading order without relying on grid position.
resilience: Uses responsive columns and accepts long metric labels.

agent.instruction: Use only with supplied evidence and test whether a non-card composition is clearer.

entries.name: ProcessSteps
entries.summary: Ordered process sequence where step numbers carry real meaning.
useWhen: Users need to understand a genuinely ordered multi-step workflow.
avoidWhen: Items can occur in any order or numbers would be decorative scaffolding.
accessibility: Use ordered-list semantics and descriptive step headings.
resilience: Steps stack on narrow viewports and allow descriptions to grow.

agent.instruction: Choose only when order is meaningful and use the supplied sequence verbatim.

entries.name: FAQList
entries.summary: FAQ-specific disclosure pattern with question and answer semantics.
useWhen: Real recurring questions need concise, independently expandable answers.
avoidWhen: The information belongs in the primary flow or is required to make a decision.
accessibility: Questions are keyboard-operable disclosure controls with programmatic expanded state.
resilience: Long answers, links, and translated questions grow without fixed heights.

agent.instruction: Use verified FAQs and keep essential product information outside collapsed answers.

entries.name: TestimonialStack
entries.summary: Readable vertical testimonial sequence for quotations of uneven length.
useWhen: Several verified quotations need to remain readable and individually attributed.
avoidWhen: A carousel would hide content or there is only one meaningful quotation.
accessibility: Preserve quotation and attribution semantics in source order.
resilience: A stack handles uneven quotation lengths without matched-height pressure.

agent.instruction: Prefer the readable stack over an auto-advancing carousel.

entries.name: PricingSummary
entries.summary: Pricing plan comparison with features, price context, and action hierarchy.
useWhen: Two to four well-defined offers need a transparent comparison.
avoidWhen: Pricing is bespoke, unavailable, or the plans cannot be compared honestly.
accessibility: Associate each price, feature list, and action with its plan heading.
resilience: Plans stack on narrow screens and feature copy wraps without clipping.

agent.instruction: Use only supplied commercial terms; never infer prices or inclusions.

entries.name: HeroSection
entries.summary: Page-opening brand statement with primary action and optional supporting visual.
useWhen: A marketing page needs one dominant promise and a clear next action.
avoidWhen: The surface is task-oriented, dense, or already has a clear page heading.
accessibility: Render the page h1 once and preserve a logical action order.
resilience: Headline and actions wrap at narrow widths; imagery has a credible fallback.

agent.instruction: Start with the supplied product truth, not generic marketing filler, then inspect desktop and mobile.

entries.name: FeatureSection
entries.summary: Feature narrative section with content and supporting media composition.
useWhen: A product capability needs explanation with evidence or a real visual.
avoidWhen: The content is only a list of generic benefits or lacks a supporting artifact.
accessibility: Keep heading order logical and provide meaningful image alternatives.
resilience: Content and media stack without changing reading order on narrow screens.

agent.instruction: Use real product capabilities and artifacts; do not generate generic icon-card grids.

entries.name: ProofSection
entries.summary: Section-level proof narrative composed from measured outcomes.
useWhen: Verified outcomes support a specific claim in the page narrative.
avoidWhen: Evidence is unavailable or the metrics would be purely decorative.
accessibility: Use descriptive headings and make every metric understandable in source order.
resilience: Proof items reflow without hiding labels or sources.

agent.instruction: Use supplied evidence only and choose a non-card treatment when comparison is not the point.

entries.name: PricingSection
entries.summary: Complete pricing section with orientation and plan comparison.
useWhen: A marketing page needs transparent plan comparison and a clear action.
avoidWhen: Pricing is bespoke or terms have not been confirmed.
accessibility: Keep plan headings, feature lists, prices, and actions programmatically grouped.
resilience: Plans stack and remain readable at narrow widths and increased text size.

agent.instruction: Use only confirmed pricing content and verify all actions resolve.

entries.name: CTASection
entries.summary: Focused closing action section with one primary next step.
useWhen: The page narrative has earned one clear next action.
avoidWhen: The same action is already repeated nearby or no real destination exists.
accessibility: Use descriptive action copy and link or button semantics that match behaviour.
resilience: Copy and actions wrap without forcing a fixed-height banner.

agent.instruction: Use one primary action and remove placeholder destinations before completion.

entries.name: FooterSection
entries.summary: Site footer with navigation groups, legal links, and brand context.
useWhen: A standalone site needs persistent secondary navigation and legal routes.
avoidWhen: The surface is embedded or does not own global site navigation.
accessibility: Label navigation groups and use real anchors for every destination.
resilience: Groups wrap or stack while preserving logical reading order.

agent.instruction: Supply real legal and navigation routes; remove empty groups.

entries.name: BlogListTemplate
entries.summary: Editorial index page composed from article previews and page-level orientation.
useWhen: A route lists editorial content with enough context to choose an article.
avoidWhen: The route is a search result, documentation navigation, or non-editorial collection.
accessibility: Use one page h1 and semantic article/list structure for previews.
resilience: Supports missing imagery, empty states, and long article metadata.

agent.instruction: Choose this before assembling a blog index from primitives.

entries.name: DocsPageTemplate
entries.summary: Documentation page with readable content measure and structured sections.
useWhen: A route presents structured product, technical, or policy documentation.
avoidWhen: The content is promotional, a dashboard, or an article index.
accessibility: Maintain sequential headings, meaningful landmarks, and descriptive links.
resilience: Long code, links, headings, and localized prose wrap or scroll intentionally.

agent.instruction: Choose this before inventing documentation layout from primitives.
